name: HedgeDoc
description: Write Markdown notes, slides and diagrams together in real time

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database with every note and account, and .session_secret, this install's own key made on first start. Back it up.

paths.name: Uploads
paths.description: Images people paste or upload into notes. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: HedgeDoc web UI, published on host as 6759

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: CMD_ALLOW_EMAIL_REGISTER
variables.description: true lets anyone make an account with an email and password on the sign-in page. Set it to false after you and your people have made accounts.

variables.name: CMD_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS
variables.description: true lets people who aren't signed in make and edit notes. Set it to false so only signed-in people can.
